title: Samsung Electronics 2026 second-quarter earnings results
excerpt: Second-quarter revenue was KRW 171.5 trillion, operating profit KRW 89.5 trillion, net profit KRW 71.6 trillion, and preferred-share EPS KRW 10,899.
summary: Samsung's detailed Q2 results provide current group and segment economics, cash, debt, cash flow, and preferred-share earnings; record memory results coexist with weak Device eXperience profitability and cyclical concentration.
